steps.content: You stand on the deck of the sand ship, the dry winds of WhiteSands howling past your ears. In the distance, sand waves surge and roll, revealing faint black shadows within them.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: This is the sand ship we've been talking about.
You take the binoculars he hands you, twist the focusing knob, and watch as the blurry silhouette gradually sharpens into focus.
It's larger than ordinary sand ships, with a sharper bow. A prominent emblem is painted on its hull.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: You should be able to see that emblem on the hull. That's the insignia of DisCorps.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Judging by its model, this ship was likely used by DisCity's military forces during the Outland War and earned distinguished achievements on the battlefield.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: This model of sand ship should have been completely decommissioned twenty years ago. And yet, here it is, roaming WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: The FAC has sent teams to approach it multiple times, but during these encounters, we discovered they likely possessed Mania weapons. That's why we requested the MBCC's assistance.
Not far from you, an FAC soldier stands at the bow, directing the loading of artillery shells.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Could this ship be smuggling Mania weapons?
As you're pondering this, something in your sight begins to move slowly.
You adjust the focus again, trying to locate whatever caught your attention in the view.
Meanwhile, an unsettling feeling of being watched slowly rises within you.
The pitch-black barrel of a cannon points directly at you, as if staring back into your eyes.
[Screen violently shakes with cannon blast sound]

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: EVERYBODY HIT THE DECK!!!
The binoculars are jolted from your hands and crash to the deck. The massive shock wave leaves you dizzy and disoriented.
You struggle to steady yourself, barely managing to focus your vision, only to see the FAC soldier who was standing at the bow now dangling from the ship's edge, about to fall at any moment.
You grit your teeth, stagger to your feet, and lunge toward the soldier.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've got you! Watch out!
The ship shakes violently again, instantly numbing your entire arm. Your grip on the ship's edge is about to give way.
In the final moment, you use all your remaining strength to fling the soldier back onto the deck, only for the momentum to throw you overboard.
The shouts behind you gradually fade away as a gale of sandy wind blasts against your face, filling your mouth and nostrils with grains.
You plunge into WhiteSands.
[Scene Change]
Zulu Zulu! You're awake!
A voice reaches your ears, muffled as if filtering through a drum skin. You struggle to open your eyes, immediately wincing as bright light stabs at your vision.
Can you stand up?
A hand is extended in front of you.
Still dazed from just regaining consciousness, you instinctively reach out and take the hand. It is slender yet strong, yanking you to your feet in one swift motion.
But your legs are still weak and you stagger, nearly falling over. A pair of shoulders quickly braces against you, holding you firmly upright.
Take it easy. No rush.
Only now do you clearly see that the person supporting you is a girl who looks barely into her teens.
This is the Ark. I'm the captain of this ship. Call me Ark.
You raise an eyebrow. This girl who looks barely of age calls herself the captain. Besides, she's carrying what appears to be... an arm cannon?
What catches your attention even more is the girl's name and voice. You can't shake the feeling that they're somehow familiar, but...
Your thoughts are interrupted as Ark's hands begin fumbling about your body. You flinch in surprise and jerk backward.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Hold still! I'm checking if you have any other injuries.
She bounces energetically around you, patting your face one moment, tugging at your arms the next, and finally gives your shoulder a confirming tap.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Looks like you're still in one piece. Zulu Zulu!
She gives your arm a gentle pat.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: In any case, you should get some proper rest first. We've prepared a cabin for you. Come with me.
As she speaks, she turns to look at a tall man standing behind her. He's staring at you intently.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Samuel, keep an eye on things while I'm busy. This passage is particularly treacherous.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...Understood.
You suddenly notice the small crowd standing behind Ark, eyeing you with caution.
The group consists of people of all ages and genders, but apart from the tall man, everyone else appears somewhat frail.
They wear the distinctive body paint and beads of WhiteSands natives. More than an ordinary sand ship, this looks more like... a cruising refugee camp?

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Ark...
An elderly man from the front of the crowd takes a few steps toward you both. There's something strange about his gait. Your eyes are drawn to his right leg... which is in fact a wooden staff.
He frowns, casting quick glances at you while muttering something in a WhiteSands dialect you can barely understand. Not compliments, that's for sure.
A young boy and a woman step forward as well, talking rapidly and gradually more loudly until they're nearly arguing. Ark smiles through it all, seemingly trying to reassure them about something.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Hey!
The elderly man suddenly points a finger at you and speaks in broken Disian.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: I warn you...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: That's enough! You're scaring our guest, Amir.
Ark interrupts him, gives your hand a gentle squeeze, and looks at you with a warm smile.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: It's okay. Come with me now!
[Scene Change]
You follow Ark down into the ship's corridor, deliberately slowing your pace to fall behind her. You seize the moment to slip a hand into your pocket and send your coordinates to the FAC.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: I'll have Samuel bring you something to eat in a bit. Yeah, that big guy from earlier... Hey, what's wrong?
She asks and quickly returns to your side.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Are you alright? Can you still walk?
She raises her hand to touch your forehead, and you nimbly remove your hand from your pocket to stop her. Your movement is smooth, and Ark seems to pay no special attention to it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm fine... I'm just a slow walker.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Well... you sure look like one! And yet you still dared to wander around WhiteSands. By the way, I haven't asked yet. How did you end up knocked out in the sands?

You study the WhiteSands-esque face paint on her cheeks and remind yourself how little you know about this ship named the Ark. Erring on the side of caution, you quickly fabricate a harmless identity for yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm a merchant. Was unlucky enough to run into some desert bandits on the way, and well...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Desert bandits?! How dare they operate in these parts when the Ark is right here?!

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: We just chased a bandit ship away a couple days ago! Zulu Zulu!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh? Is the Ark a patrol ship?

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: She's actually a rescue ship. Whenever we enter a new area, we broadcast survival hacks with our coordinates so that anyone in need who hears it can come find us for help.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Of course, that means bandits will always find a way to us. When they dare show up, we make sure they regret it!
The words survival hacks suddenly awaken a long-forgotten memory in you. Without thinking, you blurt out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lizards are highly nutritious. Remove the innards, cut off the head and tail, then roast them for a satisfyingly crispy texture. Alternatively, they can also be made into a stew...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: ... Just close your eyes, and it'll taste no different than chicken soup.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That was you!
Your face contorts as you shake your head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lizard meat tastes nothing like chicken, for the record.
Ark places her hands on her hips indignantly.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: But it is indeed a nutritious ingredient, isn't it? That part is true, at least!
You look at each other and burst into laughter almost simultaneously.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I once caught some messages from you guys. Back then... they helped me a great deal. Thank you.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Don't mention it! Just doing our best to help.

Your thoughts drift back to that dark, humid lighthouse, and you can almost hear the crackling static of the radio again, soothing you. Ark helped you once back then, and now she's doing it a second time.
Looking at her radiant smile, a thought suddenly crosses your mind: Perhaps she could help you a third time, by helping you find that mysterious warship?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, I basically got robbed clean by those desert bandits. I wonder if I'll ever get my things back... You said your ship regularly patrols this area. Have you perhaps seen the bandit ship I'm talking about?

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You want your stuff back? Leave it to us! But words alone are not enough leads. There are more ships in WhiteSands than clouds in the sky. I have no idea which one you're talking about...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Oh, right! We have plenty of photos of other sand ships we've encountered in the control room. Why don't you come with me and take a look?
[Scene Change]
You arrive at the control room. Ark jogs over to the panel and immediately starts digging through a cluttered pile of documents and photographs.
Instead of hurrying after her, you take this opportunity to survey the sand ship's control room.
To your surprise, the Ark's control room is fully equipped, with perfectly arranged instruments and terminals, comparable even to some of the FAC's most active sand ships.
Your attention is drawn to a wall covered with photos. At the same time, Ark excitedly holds up a photo she's found.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Could this be the one you're talking about? We've run into it before, but it got away! This ship has cannons too...
The wall is decorated with photos of various sand ships. Among them is one with an austere silhouette, a razor-sharp bow, and a faded DisCorps emblem on its hull.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's the one.
Ark looks up at your words. She's still holding a picture in her hand as she glances with confusion at the photo wall in front of you.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: ...That one?

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Are you saying this is the ship that attacked you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. You've run into it too?
Ark continues to stare at that photo with a bewildered expression, as if still processing what you've said. In a serious tone, you begin warning her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There is something very hostile about this ship. Were you attacked when you encountered them? They might be equipped with Mania weapons...
Ark blinks several times before finally snapping out of it.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Um, no...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Because that's...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: A photo of the Ark.
Slowly, she gathers the photos in her hand and places them on the desk beside her.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Are you from DisCity? What's your relationship with those FAC guys?
You don't answer, immediately glancing toward the door. But Ark has already moved to block your way out.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You won't talk. I see.
She touches a hand to her shoulder and stretches her body.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: As I just said, the Ark is a rescue ship, but we also run into our fair share of ill-intentioned strangers. We get them out of danger, only for them to turn on us and try to seize our ship...
You hear a strange mechanical noise.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: But they're not that hard to deal with. All you need to do is just...
She raises her arm slowly, aiming the pitch-black barrel of her arm cannon somewhere beneath your feet.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Send them all to hell!!!
Before you realize what's happening, you feel hot air searing your ear. The next second, a charred pit has already appeared in the floor next to where you stand.
The hem of your trench coat is slightly singed. Fragments of fabric twirl in the air before slowly falling to the ground.
Ark smiles maliciously, aiming her arm cannon at you directly this time as she advances with unhurried steps.
Your back presses against the cold wall.
There's nowhere else to go.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not trying to take your ship, I...
The floor trembles with Ark's every step as she closes in on you. The light between you dwindles.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Too bad the Ark's cannon didn't blow you up sooner, you DisCity thief. But don't worry...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: My cannon can do the job just as well!
The next shot lands just shy of your head, sending another blast of searing air past your ear. Sparks are sprayed onto one side of your face, burning so hot that you can't keep your eyes open.

Before the rush of relief can hit you, Ark suddenly charges forward, driving her elbow directly into your cheekbone. Your vision instantly goes dark, your knees buckle, and you collapse to the ground.
With what little consciousness remains, you crawl away, trying to put as much distance as possible between you and her, desperately fighting for your survival.
Ark turns around, peering down at you. Along with her gaze, you feel the weight of Mania energy surging from her body.
She's... a Sinner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough... cough...
You stagger to your feet, grabbing the nearby desk covered in documents to steady yourself as you regain your balance.
Ark narrows her eyes, studying the desk you're using for support. Decisively, she raises her fist and charges straight at you.

Your body reacts before your mind can. You instinctively dodge sideways, but your chest slams into her shoulder. As sharp pain shoots through your head, you manage to flip up your hand and grab her wrist.
If you could just get the shackles on her, you might be able to restrain her temporarily.
A pair of hands seizes your collar from behind and slams you against the wall. You hear the sickening crack of your own bones before collapsing limply to the floor, overcome by excruciating pain.
Chaotic footsteps surround you. Before you can even lift your head, something presses down on your back with overwhelming force, rendering you completely immobile.
Doesn't feel like a foot... More like a wooden staff.

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: Abu, give me a hand here!

steps.speaker: Abu
steps.content: Ughhh... What do we do now?

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: Now we tie the intruder up.
Someone opens a nearby fire safety box and pulls out a length of rope, winding it around you in tight circles.
The open door now faces you, swinging back and forth while its metal hinges creak. The emblem painted on its surface has faded.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's... the insignia of DisCorps!

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: Don't let him turn around!
[Screen violently shakes with impact sound effect]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... I ended up in the right place after all.
This is your final thought before you black out again.
